central_node: A Friend's Prayer: Unconditional Love and Perception of the Heart
plot_summary_nodes: The speaker offers a prayer of gratitude for loyal companions and asks for strength to be a true friend.
Pledges to offer active assistance and help make friends' dreams come true.
Vows to avoid making superficial, critical 'judgements from afar'.
Concludes with a commitment to 'use my heart to see', loving friends with emotional empathy.
character_arc_nodes: The Speaker: Devoted, empathetic friend seeking grace to offer unconditional acceptance and support.
theme_and_moral_nodes: Primary Theme: Non-judgmental acceptance and active support in friendship.
Moral Lesson: True friendship relies on emotional empathy ('seeing with the heart') rather than superficial judgments.
key_grammar_nodes: Modal Verbs (May, Can): Expressing prayers/wishes (May I be) and capability (I can help).
Phrasal Expressions: Metaphorical phrases (judgements from afar, use my heart to see).
